current_metrics.methodology_label:
Same-curve zero-coupon inflation swap (ZCIS) butterfly (3-point
ZCIS curve curvature) between three pillars of the same ZCIS
curve family (e.g. USD_ZCIS 5s10s30s, EUR_ZCIS 2s5s10s, GBP_ZCIS
2s10s30s).  Computed per-trade-date via the FIXED simple-
butterfly weighting:

  butterfly_bps = (belly_zcis_pct
                   - 0.5 * (short_zcis_pct + long_zcis_pct)) * 100

where ``short_zcis_pct`` / ``belly_zcis_pct`` / ``long_zcis_pct``
are the ZCIS rate levels at ``short_tenor`` / ``belly_tenor`` /
``long_tenor`` respectively (each computed by
``calculate_inflation_swap_rate_level`` filtered by
``instrument_type='inflation_swap'`` AND
``pricing_type='zero_coupon_breakeven'`` AND
``curve_family=?`` AND ``tenor=?`` — the no-proxy guard
inherited transitively).  The three endpoint series are aligned
per-trade-date via a strict pandas inner-join on calendar
trade_date AFTER each is computed independently; the butterfly
is computed only on dates where ALL THREE endpoints exist (no
synthetic butterfly points are produced).

Fixed simple-butterfly weighting: weight tuple
``(-0.5, +1.0, -0.5)`` applied to ``(short, belly, long)``
respectively in raw inflation-swap-rate space, then * 100 to
convert to BPS.  Equivalent to
``0.5 * (2 * belly - short - long) * 100``.  Sign convention:
POSITIVE = belly is CHEAP versus the half-weighted wings (i.e.
belly ZCIS rate is HIGH relative to the wings); NEGATIVE =
belly is RICH.  Matches sovereign_bonds/butterfly's,
inflation_indexed_bonds/real_yield_butterfly's, and
inflation_indexed_bonds/breakeven_butterfly's sign convention.

Raw inflation-swap-rate space: the arithmetic stays in raw
inflation-swap-rate space — there is NO subtraction of a
model-derived basis (e.g. swap-vs-linker breakeven basis), NO
inflation-risk-premium adjustment, and NO routing through a
fitted curve object.  Each endpoint is the raw par-rate the
zero-coupon inflation swap pays for inflation compensation
against the headline index over the swap tenor.

Same-curve construction only: the input layer accepts a single
``curve_family`` field so cross-curve butterflies cannot be
expressed.  Compute additionally re-asserts that the three
endpoint reads share ``inflation_index_family``, ``index_lag``,
``interpolation``, and ``underlying_index`` (load-bearing
reference-metadata invariants of the curve), surfacing a
controlled error envelope if they do not — that would indicate
a real instrument_master inconsistency at the underlying
pillars rather than a methodology choice.

The ``inflation_index_family`` / ``index_lag`` /
``interpolation`` / ``underlying_index`` fields thread to the
wire on ``current_metrics`` AND in the canonical TimeSeries
description so a desk reader can interpret the butterfly under
the correct ZCIS convention without a second tool call.  The
output is the CURVATURE of the ZCIS curve in raw rate space —
distinct from a ZCIS curve spread (2-point difference), from a
ZCIS forward (year-weighted forward of two endpoints), and from
the linker bond-implied breakeven butterfly (3-point curvature
of bond-implied breakevens, a different inflation-compensation
object that carries inflation-risk-premium and relative
liquidity premia between the nominal sovereign and the linker
bond).

time_series_butterfly.description: Same-curve zero-coupon inflation swap (ZCIS) butterfly (EUR_ZCIS) 2Y/5Y/10Y ((belly_zcis_pct - 0.5*(short_zcis_pct + long_zcis_pct)) * 100) over the displayed window.  Curvature of the ZCIS rate curve in raw inflation-swap-rate space — NO subtraction of a model-derived basis, NO inflation-risk-premium adjustment, NO routing through a fitted curve object.  Reference: inflation_index_family='EU_HICP', index_lag='3M', interpolation='Monthly'.  These conventions differ across USD_ZCIS / EUR_ZCIS / GBP_ZCIS — same-curve butterflies are interpretable under their own curve's convention only.  Quoted in BPS (matching the inflation_swaps domain's BPS convention for curve-shape views established via inflation_swap_curve_spread).

time_series_zscore.description: Rolling z-score of the EUR_ZCIS ZCIS butterfly (in bps) over 2Y/5Y/10Y vs its own trailing window.
